icebreaker.instructions: Give a brief answer to the question (no comments from other participants).
icebreaker.question1a: What are you feeling, what are you thinking right at this moment?
icebreaker.question1b: What topic has been on your mind lately?
icebreaker.question2a: Which historical era would you like to visit? Why?
icebreaker.question2b: Which historical figure, or figure from your own life, would you like to talk to? About what?
icebreaker.question3a: Would you want to know your fate in detail in advance?
icebreaker.question3b: Knowing it's inevitable, would you still try to change something?

topicsHints.pickPrompt: Pick a topic — it will appear on everyone's screen.
topicsHints.visibleToEveryone: This topic is currently shown to all participants.
topicsHints.topic1Question: What thought, emotion, or association comes to you as you focus on this person?
topicsHints.topic2HintA: What kind of work suits this person? In what kind of organization?
topicsHints.topic2HintB: Are they an executor, or someone with creative, exploratory potential?
topicsHints.topic2HintC: How will they get along with a team? Will they build a career?
topicsHints.topic3HintA: Which well-known character from a film, animation, book, or fairy tale does this person bring to mind?
topicsHints.topic3HintB: What film genre would you cast this person in? What kind of role?
topicsHints.topic3HintC: What would that character's story be, in that work of art?
topicsHints.topic4HintA: In what artistic style would you depict this person?
topicsHints.topic4HintB: Against what background? In what clothing?
topicsHints.topic5HintA: What life script might this person be following?
topicsHints.topic5HintB: What might they not admit even to themselves? What might they not suspect about themselves?
topicsHints.topic5HintC: In which relationships might they be "toxic", and in which would they fit in naturally?
